results.question: Can you describe a challenging bug you encountered during your internship at TechSolutions Inc. and how you approached resolving it?
results.answer: During my internship at TechSolutions, I was working on a backend API when we started seeing intermittent failures for a particular endpoint. My first step was to reproduce the issue locally and review the application logs to narrow down where the failure was occurring. After some investigation, I found that the problem only happened when certain database values were missing, and our code wasn't handling those cases properly. I updated the validation and error handling logic, tested several edge cases, and confirmed the endpoint behaved correctly afterward. That experience reinforced the importance of debugging methodically and validating assumptions before jumping to a solution.

results.question: Can you walk me through a specific feature you developed during your internship at TechSolutions, explaining your design choices and any challenges you faced?
results.answer: One feature I developed was the data retrieval component of my Weather Dashboard project. I designed the application to call a third-party weather API, process the response, and display the forecast in a simple, user-friendly interface. One challenge was handling cases where the API request failed or returned incomplete data, so I added error handling to display clear messages instead of letting the application break. I also kept the frontend and backend responsibilities separated, which made the code easier to maintain and update as I added new features.

results.question: What strategies do you use to ensure the applications you develop are both reliable and scalable, especially in a customer-facing environment like the one described in this role?
results.answer: I try to write clean and organized code so it's easier to maintain and less likely to introduce bugs. I also like to test my work with different inputs and edge cases before considering a feature finished. If I know an application will have more users over time, I try to keep the design modular so new features can be added without changing everything. In a customer-facing environment, I think reliability is especially important because users expect the application to work consistently, so I would also pay close attention to debugging issues and fixing problems quickly.

job_description.text:
Software Engineer - New Graduate

About the Role

We are looking for a new graduate Software Engineer to join our engineering team and help build reliable, scalable applications used by customers and internal teams. You will work closely with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to design features, improve existing systems, and solve technical problems across the software development lifecycle.

Responsibilities

- Design, build, test, and maintain software applications and backend services
- Develop and integrate REST APIs used by internal and customer-facing applications
- Debug production issues and investigate system failures using logs, metrics, and testing tools
- Work with relational databases and write queries to support application features
- Collaborate with engineers and product teams to translate requirements into technical solutions
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
- Help improve application reliability, performance, and scalability
- Learn new technologies and frameworks as needed for different projects
- Contribute to cloud-based deployments and modern development workflows

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
- Experience programming in Python, Java, JavaScript, or a similar language
- Understanding of object-oriented programming and common software design principles
- Familiarity with REST APIs, HTTP, and backend application development
- Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL
- Understanding of Git and collaborative software development workflows
- Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills
- Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and work effectively in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
- Familiarity with Docker or containerized applications
- Exposure to frontend frameworks such as React
- Experience with automated testing or CI/CD workflows
- Familiarity with machine learning or AI-powered applications
